title: Length of Longest V-Shaped Diagonal Segment
summary: Given a 2D integer matrix grid of size n x m, where each element is either 0, 1, or 2, find the length of the longest V-shaped diagonal segment.
statement: Given a 2D integer matrix grid of size n x m, where each element is either 0, 1, or 2, find the length of the longest V-shaped diagonal segment. A V-shaped diagonal segment starts with 1 and follows the sequence 2, 0, 2, 0, ..., which may include at most one clockwise 90-degree turn to another diagonal direction while maintaining the sequence. If no valid segment exists, return 0.
constraints: grid is a nonempty matrix of 0, 1, and 2 values.
A path starts at 1 and then alternates 2,0,2,0 along diagonal steps.
It may continue straight or make at most one clockwise 90-degree turn; return its maximum length.
hints: The future depends on cell, direction, and whether the single clockwise turn remains.
Memoize a recursive extension for each state and start it from every cell containing one.
Require the next alternating value; recurse straight, and when available also recurse after rotating the direction clockwise.
Every valid segment has one start and a unique sequence of straight/turn choices, all represented by the memoized state graph.
editorial: Every valid segment has one start and a unique sequence of straight/turn choices, all represented by the memoized state graph.

tests.explanation: The longest valid diagonal follows the alternating sequence through five cells with one clockwise turn.
A single starting one is itself a valid segment of length one.
